title: 10 Billion LEGO Minifigures Now Outnumber Humans
hook: 10 billion minifigures means LEGO already outnumbered humanity.
closing: A toy population now exceeds ours, and its lead keeps growing.
question: How many minifigures are in your house?

segments.say: LEGO has made 10 billion minifigures, enough to outnumber the world's living population.
Cumulative LEGO minifigures reached 8.3 billion, crossing a population-scale threshold before the latest total.
LEGO produces 400 million minifigures yearly, so the toy population keeps growing faster than humanity.
